title: The comparative datasets as tabulated registrations
statement: The corpus's curated comparative datasets — the flood-myth concordance, the divine-council index, the theomachy cross-references, the prophets-and-religions table, the world-ages table, and the motif-index derivatives — are tabulated registrations, each row a per-tradition registration at its stated grade against a named primary source; a dataset is a research instrument serving its governing claims, and tabulation is never accumulation: rows sharing a textual stream are one datum under the independence-of-evidence principle, and no dataset's size is an argument.

includes: The row discipline: per-tradition registration, named primary source, stated relationship grade (resemblance, dependence, typology) — the discipline the datasets' own curation rules already enforce

The service mapping: each dataset serves its governing claim(s) — flood-myths to 0010, divine-council to 0011, theomachy-crossrefs to 0008, prophets-and-religions to 0038, world-ages to 0003, the motif-index derivatives to the 0056 surface
The independence rule as binding: rows in one documented stream (the Atrahasis-Gilgamesh-Genesis line above all) are one datum however many rows carry them
The both-ways function: a dataset that registers a tradition's divergence is doing its job exactly as much as one that registers convergence
excludes: Dataset size or coverage as evidence for any claim; counting is the named forbidden move
Rows as endorsements; a registration records that a comparison exists at a grade, not that it succeeds
The technical datasets (the content graph), which are infrastructure, not registrations
Curation-rule changes, which are editorial process, not this record's content

source_references.locator: The documented stream whose rows exemplify the one-datum rule (ATRA-WOH; the flood concordance's central column)
The structuralist account of what tabulated myth-patterns show — the standing alternative reading of every dataset

alternatives.statement: Curated datasets register what curators sought; the tables' shapes reflect the framework's questions, and neutrality claims for them overstate.
Instruments become arguments by exposure: publishing tables invites size-reading whatever the record forbids, and the discipline is unenforceable at the reader.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0056 is revised or retired.
A governing claim's revision changes what its dataset serves.
Corpus prose begins counting rows as evidence, the named forbidden move.
